result.instructions: Tools for Accelo, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Accelo data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run accelo_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run accelo_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run accelo_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. accelo_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: list_companies
tools.title: List companies
tools.description: List companies (client organizations). Accelo API: GET /api/v0/companies. Supports _page/_limit/_fields/_filters/_search. Returns { meta, response }.

fields.description: _fields: comma-separated extra fields to include in each object, or "_ALL" for every available field.

filters.description: _filters: Accelo filter string, function-like and comma-separated. E.g. status(1), date_created_after(1704067200), order_by_desc(date_created), search(acme). Suffix _not for negation; combine with _OR(...)/_AND(...). Passed through verbatim as _filters.

search.description: _search: free-text search across the object's searchable fields.

tools.name: accelo_request
tools.title: Raw read request
tools.description: Power-user escape hatch: GET any Accelo API path not wrapped by a dedicated tool. READ-ONLY — only GET is allowed. Pass the FULL API path after the host, starting with a slash, INCLUDING any query string, e.g. "/api/v0/companies?_limit=1&_filters=status(1)" or "/api/v0/tasks/123". Returns { meta, response }.

path.description: Full API path after the host, starting with "/", e.g. "/api/v0/invoices?_limit=5".

tools.name: create_company
tools.title: Create a company
tools.description: MUTATES Accelo data: creates a new company (client organization). Accelo API: POST /api/v0/companies (form-encoded). Returns { meta, response } with the created company. (Accelo has no separate delete tool here; to UPDATE, POST to /api/v0/companies/{id}.)

status_id.description: Company status id (from your deployment's company statuses).

fields.description: Additional documented Accelo fields to send in the write body (merged with the typed fields above).

tools.name: create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: MUTATES Accelo data: creates a new contact (a person). Accelo API: POST /api/v0/contacts (form-encoded). NOTE: a contact's company affiliation is set separately via an affiliation (POST /api/v0/contacts/{id}/affiliations), not on creation. Returns { meta, response } with the created contact.

fields.description: Additional documented Accelo fields to send in the write body (merged with the typed fields above).

tools.name: create_task
tools.title: Create a task
tools.description: MUTATES Accelo data: creates a new task. Accelo tasks are always logged AGAINST an object (a job, company, issue, etc.), so against_type + against_id are required. Accelo API: POST /api/v0/tasks (form-encoded). Returns { meta, response }.

against_type.description: The object type this task is logged against, e.g. "job", "company", "issue", "prospect" (required).

against_id.description: The id of the object this task is logged against (required).

date_started.description: Start date as a Unix timestamp (seconds).

date_due.description: Due date as a Unix timestamp (seconds).

fields.description: Additional documented Accelo fields to send in the write body (merged with the typed fields above).

tools.name: create_activity
tools.title: Create an activity (log a note/email/call)
tools.description: MUTATES Accelo data: logs an activity (a note, email, call, or meeting) against an object. This is the highest-value safe write — e.g. add a note/comment to a job or company. against_type + against_id say what it is logged against (required). Accelo API: POST /api/v0/activities (form-encoded). Returns { meta, response }.

against_type.description: The object type this activity is logged against, e.g. "company", "job", "issue", "prospect", "contact" (required).

against_id.description: The id of the object this activity is logged against (required).

body.description: The activity body/message text (the note content).

medium.description: Communication medium, e.g. "note", "email", "call", "meeting". Defaults to a note on the Accelo side.

owner_type.description: The owner object type, e.g. "staff" (who logged/owns the activity).

owner_id.description: The owner id (e.g. the staff id).

fields.description: Additional documented Accelo fields to send in the write body (merged with the typed fields above).
